text: The PNG Tsunami Guide initiative is a comprehensive program aimed at enhancing tsunami risk management in Papua New Guinea. It focuses on developing practical guidance and strengthening capabilities from hazard assessment and warning to land-use planning, vertical evacuation, and resilient infrastructure planning. The initiative is part of the broader IOC-UNESCO Tsunami Programme and PNG's disaster risk management and climate-resilient infrastructure initiatives.
